title: agent-array / Fleet overview
description: Every node ($node, $node, $node, $node as they join): Ready state, CPU, memory, disk, network and temperatures. Host names come from the aa:node:info recording rule (monitoring/alerts/rules/$nodeluster.rules.yaml).

panels.title: Nodes Ready
panels.description: Nodes whose Ready condition is true (kube-state-metrics).

targets.expr: sum(kube_node_status_condition{job="kube-state-metrics", condition="Ready", status="true"})

panels.title: Nodes joined
panels.description: Nodes registered with k3s. Expected: $node, $node, $node, $node ($node later).

targets.expr: count(kube_node_info{job="kube-state-metrics"})

panels.title: NotReady
panels.description: Nodes whose Ready condition is false or unknown.

targets.expr: sum(kube_node_status_condition{job="kube-state-metrics", condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Cordoned
panels.description: Cordoned nodes (a GPU rig put to sleep by Hermes is cordoned first).

targets.expr: sum(kube_node_spec_unschedulable{job="kube-state-metrics"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Hottest CPU package
panels.description: Highest CPU package temperature across nodes. NodeCPUTemperatureHigh warns above 90C for 10m.

targets.expr: max(aa:node_cpu_package_temp:celsius)

panels.title: Hottest GPU
panels.description: Highest GPU temperature (DCGM). GPUTemperatureHigh warns above 83C for 10m and is critical above 90C. Empty until the GPU rigs join and gpu/03 (DCGM exporter) is deployed.

targets.expr: max(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{job=~".*dcgm-exporter.*"})

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: One row per k8s node. Uptime comes from node-exporter on that node.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{job="kube-state-metrics", condition="Ready", status="true"}), "host", "$1", "node", "(.+)") and on (node) kube_node_info{node=~"$node"}
label_replace(1 - max by (node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable{job="kube-state-metrics"}), "host", "$1", "node", "(.+)") and on (node) kube_node_info{node=~"$node"}

label_replace(max by (node, kubelet_version, internal_ip, kernel_version, os_image) (kube_node_info{job="kube-state-metrics"}), "host", "$1", "node", "(.+)") and on (node) kube_node_info{node=~"$node"}
label_replace(max by (node) (kube_node_status_capacity{job="kube-state-metrics", resource="cpu"}), "host", "$1", "node", "(.+)") and on (node) kube_node_info{node=~"$node"}
label_replace(max by (node) (kube_node_status_capacity{job="kube-state-metrics", resource="memory"}), "host", "$1", "node", "(.+)") and on (node) kube_node_info{node=~"$node"}

label_replace(max by (node) ((time() - node_boot_time_seconds{job="node-exporter"}) * on (instance) group_left (node) max by (instance, node) (aa:node:info)), "host", "$1", "node", "(.+)") and on (node) kube_node_info{node=~"$node"}
label_replace(count by (node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics"}), "host", "$1", "node", "(.+)") and on (node) kube_node_info{node=~"$node"}

panels.title: Node Ready over time
panels.description: Ready condition per node. A gap means kube-state-metrics had no data.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{job="kube-state-metrics", condition="Ready", status="true"}), "host", "$1", "node", "(.+)") and on (node) kube_node_info{node=~"$node"}

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Share of CPU time not idle, averaged over all threads of each host.

targets.expr: 1 - avg by (host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter", mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: CPU iowait and steal
panels.description: iowait: threads idle while waiting on disk. steal: time taken by the hypervisor (should be 0 on the dedicated boxes).

targets.expr: avg by (host, mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter", mode=~"iowait|steal"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: Load average per thread
panels.description: Load average divided by the number of hardware threads. Above 1 means runnable tasks are queueing.

targets.expr: max by (host) (node_load1{job="node-exporter"} * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"})) / max by (host) (count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter", mode="idle"}) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

max by (host) (node_load5{job="node-exporter"} * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"})) / max by (host) (count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter", mode="idle"}) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: CPU pressure (PSI some)
panels.description: Share of wall time in which at least one runnable task waited for a CPU. The factory design's over-packing target is under 0.25 on $node.

targets.expr: max by (host) (rate(node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total{job="node-exporter"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: 1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal. kps NodeMemoryHighUtilization warns at 90%, AgentArrayNodeMemoryExhausted at 95%.

targets.expr: max by (host) ((1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"}) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

max by (host) ((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"}) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))
max by (host) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"} * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: tmpfs (shmem) and page cache
panels.description: Organization service and host telemetry; missing optional exporters remain visible as unknown.

targets.expr: max by (host) (node_memory_Shmem_bytes{job="node-exporter"} * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))
max by (host) (node_memory_Cached_bytes{job="node-exporter"} * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: Memory pressure (PSI full)
panels.description: Share of time in which all non-idle tasks stalled on memory. AgentArrayNodeMemoryStall warns above 10% for 10m.

targets.expr: max by (host) (rate(node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total{job="node-exporter"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: Filesystem used
panels.description: Used share per mounted filesystem. AgentArrayDiskSpaceLow warns under 10% free on / and /models.

targets.expr: max by (host, mountpoint) ((1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|squashfs|overlay|nsfs|fuse.*|efivarfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|squashfs|overlay|nsfs|fuse.*|efivarfs"}) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: Disk throughput (read +, write -)
panels.description: Physical devices only (md RAID and device-mapper devices excluded, so RAID1 writes count on both members).

targets.expr: sum by (host) (rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{job="node-exporter", device!~"loop.*|ram.*|dm-.*|sr.*|md.*"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

sum by (host) (rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="node-exporter", device!~"loop.*|ram.*|dm-.*|sr.*|md.*"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: Disk busy
panels.description: Share of time each device had IO in flight.

targets.expr: max by (host, device) (rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{job="node-exporter", device!~"loop.*|ram.*|dm-.*|sr.*|md.*"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: Physical NIC throughput (rx +, tx -)
panels.description: Physical interfaces only (Interface sub-interfaces excluded; their frames are already counted on the parent NIC). Per-interface detail and the Interface budget: agent-array / Network.

targets.expr: sum by (host) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{job="node-exporter", device=~"(en|eth|wl).+", device!~".+[.].+"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"})) * 8

sum by (host) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="node-exporter", device=~"(en|eth|wl).+", device!~".+[.].+"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"})) * 8

sum by (host, device) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{job="node-exporter", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"})) * 8

sum by (host, device) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="node-exporter", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"})) * 8

panels.title: CPU package temperature
panels.description: k10temp/zenpower temp1 (Tctl/Tdie) on AMD, coretemp package on Intel. NodeCPUTemperatureHigh: above 90C for 10m.

targets.expr: max by (host) (aa:node_cpu_package_temp:celsius * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: GPU temperature
panels.description: DCGM core temperature, by the k8s node of the exporter pod. GPUTemperatureHigh: warning above 83C for 10m, critical above 90C for 5m.

targets.expr: max by (node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{job=~".*dcgm-exporter.*"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics"}))

panels.title: All hardware temperature sensors
panels.description: Every node_hwmon_temp_celsius sensor: CPU (k10temp Tctl/Tccd), NVMe composite and sensors, DIMM (jc42).

targets.expr: max by (host, chip_name, sensor, label) (((node_hwmon_temp_celsius{job="node-exporter"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left (label) max by (instance, chip, sensor, label) (node_hwmon_sensor_label{job="node-exporter"})) or on (instance, chip, sensor) node_hwmon_temp_celsius{job="node-exporter"}) * on (instance, chip) group_left (chip_name) max by (instance, chip, chip_name) (node_hwmon_chip_names{job="node-exporter"}) * on (instance) group_left (host) max by (instance, host) (aa:node:info{host=~"$host"}))
